hypothesis: Persistent original-node recurrent composition through a deterministic Euler closed walk and its reverse may be a useful alternative hierarchy factorization before original HCG/singleinst. Each directed event updates only its receiver from the current receiver/sender states; reverse traversal continues the first traversal states. Whole-graph efficacy and novelty are UNKNOWN.
mechanism: h_v=GELU(W[h_v,h_u]); original-ID DFS closed tour2E followed by reverse closed tour2E, one persistent C-state per supported original node. Final states supply three deltas to original cf skips.
control: M95 original exact YAML and matched two natural TRAIN batches/resources

parameter_inference.scope: Source algebra only, actual inventory unmeasured

risks: Order sensitivity; reverse does not guarantee permutation invariance
Long serial recurrence/autograd and kernel/Python overhead
No proven new downstream coverage, deficit, efficacy or novelty
